title: tc-judge-sampling
description:
How much of an agent's traffic an LLM judge reads, and what it costs – a sampling rate per segment, rules that
always include a chat, the judge model, and live estimates of chats judged, monthly cost and what the sample can
see, with a budget cap that warns.

segments.description: The traffic segments, each with its chats a day

includeRules.description: Rules that always include a chat, whatever the rate

models.description: The judge models to choose from, with a price per chat

value.description: The settings. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

currency.description: The currency for prices and the budget, e.g. "USD"

scoreSd.description: How spread out the judge's scores are (their standard deviation), for what the sample can see

detect.description: The drop in the average score worth seeing, e.g. 0.2 on a 1–5 scale

locale.description: The language for numbers, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

chatsPerDay.description: Chats a day in this segment

description.description: One line on what it catches

chatsPerDay.description: Chats a day it matches – added on top of the sample

costPerChat.description: What judging one chat costs, in `currency`
